Update provider names declared by the app. Enabling this can fix installation errors, but this can also break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Customize app branding (name and icon)

options.description:
App icon source.

            Special values:
            - Original: Keep the original app icon.
            - Bundled: Use the bundled icon from patches/src/main/resources/custom-branding.

            Any other value is treated as a folder path with custom DCinside launcher icons.

            A custom icon folder must contain one or more of the following directories:
            - mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi

            Each icon directory must contain exactly one launcher icon file:
            - ic_launcher.png
- ic_launcher.webp

            The expected launcher icon sizes are:
            - mipmap-mdpi: 48x48 px
- mipmap-hdpi: 72x72 px
- mipmap-xhdpi: 96x96 px
- mipmap-xxhdpi: 144x144 px
- mipmap-xxxhdpi: 192x192 px

            Optionally, you can provide a notification icon as either:
            - drawable/ic_symbol.xml
            - drawable-<dpi>/ic_symbol.png or ic_symbol.webp with sizes:
            - drawable-mdpi: 24x24 px
- drawable-hdpi: 36x36 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 48x48 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 72x72 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 96x96 px

Adding the Loco Packet Handler allows external applications to handle the app's packets, which may compromise security.
Conflicts may occur on some systems.

patches.name: Add settings tab
patches.description: Adds a settings tab to the app.

patches.name: Allow Hide on Any Chat
patches.description: Users with hiding privileges can hide any chat, including their own messages.

patches.name: Allow invisible characters
patches.description: Stops zero width and other invisible characters from being stripped out of the chat input and out of the messages shown in a chat room.

patches.name: Allow open chat media bundle
patches.description: Removes the open chat restriction that stops webp, gif and other media from being bundled into a single multi-photo message.

patches.name: Allow profile media download
patches.description: Adds the save option of the profile media viewer to the profile pictures and background images of other people.

patches.name: Allow reply to feed
patches.description: Adds a setting to allow swiping feed messages to reply, or to comment where chat room comments are enabled.

patches.name: Always Show Kick Button
patches.description: Always shows the kick button in group member management.

patches.name: Block reactions on deleted or hidden messages
patches.description: Stops reactions, including the double tap gesture, from being sent on messages that the server considers deleted or hidden and that are only still visible because they are kept by a patch.

patches.name: Block replies on deleted or hidden messages
patches.description: Stops the swipe gesture, and any reply or comment send, from targeting messages that the server considers deleted or hidden and that are only still visible because they are kept by a patch.

patches.name: Bypass input mention limit in non-multichat
patches.description: Bypass the limit of input mentions in non-multichat rooms

patches.name: Bypass Moat check
patches.description: Add a setting to bypass the KakaoPay Moat integrity check. It stops the native scan from running, so the tamper/root/hook verdict is never computed or reported and KakaoPay is not force-closed. Payments on a modified build are still risky.

patches.description: Always show the real unread count instead of '300+' in chatroom list

patches.name: Disable 99 unread limit
patches.description: Skip the 99-cap so unread count shows full value

patches.name: Disable abuse detection report
patches.description: Answers the startup and login integrity challenge with an empty token and a benign Play Integrity failure code instead of a Google-signed token that would expose the re-signed certificate. The report itself is still sent, so the client does not go conspicuously silent on the server's nonce the way suppressing it entirely would.

patches.name: Disable AdFit environment detection
patches.description: Stops the AdFit ad SDK from reporting a root or emulator verdict to its telemetry and ad request endpoints.

patches.name: Disable Friend Feed tab

patches.name: Disable Friend Lists ad

patches.description: Disables the OpenChat tab feed ad load and render paths.

patches.name: Disable Pay banner ad

patches.name: Remove focus ad
patches.description: Removes the focus ad from the app.

patches.name: Remove More tab ad
patches.description: Removes the ad from the More tab.

patches.name: Remove native ad
patches.description: Removes the native ad from the app.

patches.description: Removes the OpenLink chat room list ad.

patches.name: Remove shop tab
patches.description: Removes the shop tab from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Remove Short-form Tab
patches.description: Removes the Short-form tab from the now fragment.

patches.description: Restores the removed keyword notification collection view along with its chat list entry.

patches.name: Show chatroom channel ID
patches.description: Shows the channel ID in chatroom settings and copies it when tapping the chat side title.

patches.name: Show deleted, hidden, or edited messages
patches.description: Allows you to see deleted, hidden, and edited message history in chat logs.

patches.description: Shows the members who have or have not read each chat message.

patches.name: Show messages restricted to mobile
patches.description: Shows the content of AlimTalk, Leverage and Universal messages that are replaced with a placeholder asking to open them on mobile while signed in on a sub device.

patches.name: Spoof apk checksums
patches.description: Spoofs the apk checksums to pass integrity checks.

patches.name: Spoof App ID
patches.description: Spoofs the App ID to bypass integrity checks. (to bypass biometric auth etc.)

patches.name: Spoof attestation package name
patches.description: Reports the original package name in the attestation report, which otherwise reveals a renamed install. Only the report is affected, so the app keeps using its real package name everywhere else.

patches.name: Spoof installer package name
patches.description: Reports Google Play as the install source in the integrity report, which otherwise reveals a sideloaded install.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the app signature to pass integrity checks.

patches.name: Strip image metadata
patches.description: Removes EXIF metadata, including the GPS capture location, from images sent in original quality, while keeping the picture and its orientation intact.

patches.name: Version info patch
patches.description: Patches the version info to include '(ReVanced)' in the version string.

patches.name: Auto claim TongPow
patches.description: Automatically claims CHZZK TongPow rewards when they become available while watching streams.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables CHZZK advertisements, including live stream pre-roll, mid-roll and post-roll ads and clip feed ads.

patches.name: Disable P2P
patches.description: Disables CHZZK peer-assisted grid streaming and forces CDN playback.

patches.name: Hide home banners
patches.description: Hides promotional banners on the CHZZK home recommend tab, including the top banner carousel and the in-feed event and image banners.

patches.name: Unlock cheat key
patches.description: Unlocks CHZZK cheat key subscription benefits without an active subscription.

patches.name: Enable non-One UI ROM support
patches.description: Makes Samsung Keyboard installable and usable on non-One UI ROMs.

patches.name: Disable P2P
patches.description: Disables SOOP peer-assisted grid streaming.

patches.name: Remove banner ads
patches.description: Removes the VOD companion and search banner ads.

patches.name: Remove Catch ads
patches.description: Removes the ads inserted between clips in the Catch feed by reporting no ad slots.

patches.name: Remove exit dialog ad
patches.description: Removes the ad area shown in the app-exit confirmation dialog, keeping the dialog itself.

patches.name: Remove intro ads
patches.description: Removes the image, video and cinema intro ad banners shown on launch.

patches.name: Remove list banner ads
patches.description: Removes the native banner ads under the live player and in feeds by stopping their ad request, so no banner is fetched or shown.

patches.name: Remove live ads
patches.description: Removes the live pre-roll ad by routing every ad decision into the app's own no-video path so the stream starts immediately.

patches.name: Remove live banner ads
patches.description: Removes the banner ads shown under the live player by stopping their driver from attaching the banner fragments.

patches.name: Remove main board ads
patches.description: Removes the native "main board" banner ad shown in feeds and under the live player.

patches.name: Remove VOD ads
patches.description: Removes VOD pre-roll ads by reporting every stream as QuickView Plus to the player's own ad-skip check.
